row.title: Integration round 1 of the specification run shipped: build-out modules wired into the composition root
row.body: The modules earlier slices merged unwired (router caps, elicit outcomes, claims reap and prune, build-out ports, githubPullReader) now run in core/org, and the small module defects the round-two review found are closed. Evidence: workers core and packs 2,061 tests with 0 fail, seed suites and each foundation test file pass, conformance check 0 problems; the slice was carried onto the latest main by cherry-pick and is 58 files, 1,128 lines.
